name: Sauk River (Darrington – Sauk)
blurb: Wild and Scenic glacial river below Darrington — fast, braided, cold and full of wood.

sections.notes: Braided channels — wood and logjams move every season. Not a tubing river: cold, swift glacial water. USFS says no fees are required at Lower Sauk Boat Launch (day use, sunrise to sunset). Fee status at Sauk Prairie not confirmed.

Government Bridge take-out is informal: limited parking, no facilities, short carry, 0.3 mi upstream of the bridge on river left. USFS says no fees are required at Lower Sauk Boat Launch (day use, sunrise to sunset). Government Bridge is an informal access; fee status not confirmed.

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.
